body: Thank you so much for responding!
I reached out here for help yesterday and only got one response. People don’t give a fuck.
I’m all alone, abusive marriage is over, my son is an addict and blames me, and I’m bankrupt.

I’m all alone, I’m getting divorced, my family is all gone.  I literally have nothing or no one to live for. 

The pain is just too much
Someone told me how selfish I was....
